description: From Münsterplatz, Basel Minster fills the frame as a red sandstone west front, with the Georgsturm and the slightly shorter Martinsturm and a patterned tile roof. Canon houses line the square. The Rhine and the Mittlere Brücke are not in this view, that river crossing is a separate scene, and no scaffolding or readable banner is added. The Open-Meteo model is fully overcast and windy, with no rain.
